item.title: Noida girl apologises after case over remarks against PM Modi
item.description: A fifteen-year-old girl from Noida, who was booked following a video showing her using abusive language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi during a protest, has released an apology video. In her statement, she expressed deep regret, stating she is very young and that it was her first and last mistake, while seeking forgiveness from the entire nation. Meanwhile, the legal case has been transferred to Delhi, and a salon owner has alleged that she concealed her identity during an interaction.

item.title: Fifa scraps controversial World Cup investment plan
item.description: Football governing body Fifa has abandoned its controversial plan to sell off stakes in major tournaments. This decision follows widespread opposition from various quarters to a proposal put forward by Fifa president Gianni Infantino. Consequently, the organization has dropped the initiative to secure outside investment for its flagship competitions, bowing to the significant pushback received against the scheme.

item.description: The newly appointed chancellor has announced that the upcoming budget will take place in October. item.title: FIFA chief Infantino drops World Cup sell-off plan

item.title: Jana Nayagan box office: Vijay and Pooja Hegde film crosses Rs 268 crore worldwide
item.description: The Vijay and Pooja Hegde starrer 'Jana Nayagan' entered its second weekend by crossing the Rs 268 crore mark at the global box office by day nine. Although the film experienced a dip in daily domestic collections on its eighth day, it continues a strong theatrical run. Reports indicate the movie is nearing the Rs 300 crore milestone and is poised to surpass the lifetime collection of 'Good Bad Ugly'. It had earlier crossed the Rs 250 crore worldwide milestone within its first week of release.

The protest, which featured saffron robes, drew sharp condemnation from the BJP, Vishva Hindu Parishad, and various seers, who demanded the expulsion of the participating MPs. Meanwhile, Rajya Sabha proceedings were adjourned amid widespread protests. While regional parties like the SP urged the opposition to focus on the Ayodhya issue, the Congress party shifted its primary attention toward police crackdowns, according to reports.

item.description: Ten people have died following a building collapse in Bhiwandi. The civic body stated that the structure was previously declared dangerous, with three notices issued, water and power supplies cut, and residents told to vacate, though residents have denied these claims. Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed grief over the fatalities and announced ex gratia financial relief for the affected families. Authorities are currently investigating illegal repairs carried out on the hazardous premises. Further details regarding rescue operations and accountability remain limited at this stage.

Meanwhile, Harsh Singh clinched the men's -60kg gold by defeating an experienced Australian opponent. item.title: NASA Tests Webbings for Oxygen-Rich Lunar and Martian Missions
item.description: NASA has published flammability test results for commercial-off-the-shelf webbings intended for future missions to the Moon and Mars, which involve elevated oxygen environments. Evaluations focused on materials meeting stringent space agency safety standards. Specifically, testing showed that a natural webbing made from sixty percent Kevlar and forty percent polybenzimidazole, manufactured by Sturges Manufacturing Company, successfully cleared the required flammability assessments.

item.title: NASA and SpaceX Complete Wind Tunnel Tests for Starship
item.description: NASA and SpaceX have finished new wind tunnel tests on the Super Heavy Version 3 rocket booster at Ames Research Center in California. These evaluations support preparations for the upcoming Artemis III demonstration mission. Experts examined the extreme aerodynamic forces the rocket faces during re-entry to gather critical data. Such collaborations between the agency and industry partners aim to enhance vehicle design and mission safety for future space exploration goals.
